name: zsnd_group_queue_pending_loads_from_config_node
description: zSndGroup_QueuePendingLoadsFromConfigNode ensures the pending stream list exists, loads child sound groups from a SOUND_GROUPS reader array, and queues each successful payload.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs; all tested profiles left 78 unmasked mismatches after direct node-array source-shape cleanup.

Reviewed triage shows the remaining drift is in prologue/register allocation, zArchiveList wrapper symbol shape, and call/loop scheduling; the source now matches the original direct readerNode->value.nodes and nodeArray[0].value.i32 count access.
Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around child-node array walks rendered as byte pointer math.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a4530 validates the array-type guard, lazy creation of g_zSndStream_PendingList through zArchiveList::CreateEmpty, iteration from child index 1 through the SOUND_GROUPS node array, payload construction through zSndGroup_LoadFromConfigNode, PushFrontPayload for non-null payloads, and return value semantics.
The native load-and-queue smoke verifies zSndGroup_QueuePendingLoadsFromConfigNode returns success for a two-child group list, creates the pending list, and queues two loaded zSndGroup payloads.
